# Budget spreadsheet

The Google Sheet is called `HH-Budget-v7` (v6 had broken formulas from the month I added the flat, don't use it).

## Tabs

1. **Inputs**: invoices received, rent from the flat, child benefit (£2,212 a year for both, we're under the HICBC threshold since April 2024)
2. **Fixed**: everything on direct debit
3. **Variable**: groceries, fuel, kids' stuff, birthdays
4. **Sinking**: car, Christmas, holiday, the flat's annual costs
5. **Tax pot**: 28% of every invoice goes to the Starling tax space the day it lands

## Fixed monthly, Jan 2025

| Item | £ |
|---|---|
| Mortgage (Nationwide, 2-year fix to May 2026) | 1,126.40 |
| Council tax, Leeds band C | 168.00 |
| Energy (Octopus, Flexible) | 147.00 |
| Car insurance, monthly | 41.32 |
| Life cover (two policies) | 38.90 |
| Broadband + phones | 72.00 |
| Water, Yorkshire Water | 46.50 |
| Isla swimming + Theo football | 64.00 |

Fixed total: £1,704.12. With variable averaging £1,246 over the last 6 months, household outgoings land at roughly £2,950, which feeds the [[Emergency fund]] target.

## Sinking funds

- Car: £90/month. Covers MOT, service, tyres. Repayments are separate, see [[Car loan]].
- Christmas: £80/month, capped at £960
- Summer holiday: £200/month, 2025 is Northumberland not abroad
- Flat: £150/month for gas safety cert, landlord policy, letting agent's renewal fee

## Rules I actually follow

- Reconcile on the first Saturday of the month, kids at swimming, 45 minutes max
- Anything over £250 not in the sheet waits 72 hours
- Variable overspend comes out of next month's variable, never out of sinking funds

There's a Spanish version of the household side for Javier, simplified: [[Presupuesto familiar]].
